requirement: WO resolves missing facts to approved neutral wording in the site language and validates slot provenance

oracle.invariant: Every neutral key used by the vocabulary and sidecars resolves in all ten site languages; unknown locales fall back to English. Contact requires a contact page, email or phone; Call requires a phone even when its policy omits the requirement. Step indices 0 and 1 render 01 and 02; missing facts never create people, prices, claims or forbidden filler. The manifest accepts the four supported states and rejects duplicate slots, invalid fields and contradictory provenance. All tests pass.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
